Definition: a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitants of Shomeron
BiblicalUsage: Shomroni is a Samaritan, an inhabitant of Samaria, and the word appears once, where every nation settled in the land made gods of its own and set them in the high places the Samaritans had made. The religion of Samaria was a mixture, a god for every city and a shrine for every nation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mixed religion is no religion at all. The Samaritans kept the high places and added gods to them, and I hold that God will not share His altar.
